page_title: UNI 1-0 LEV | Union Berlin v Bayer Leverkusen 21/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+7' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails narrowly wide of the right post!
90+4' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
90+3' Frederik Ronnow (Union Berlin) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
90+1' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header narrowly over the crossbar!
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
88' Yellow card. Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
88' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
86' That will be all from Andrej Ilic who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin).
85' Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) comes onto the pitch after Andras Schafer signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
84' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
83' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.

82' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the middle of the goal. However, he couldn't beat Janis Blaswich, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
81' The game has come to an end for Malik Tillman. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen).
81' The ball possession at the moment is 37:63.
78' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up a rebound, moves into space and fires a shot at goal from long range that rises sharply and curls well wide of the right post.
78' Bayer Leverkusen will take a corner kick.
76' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bayer Leverkusen.

75' Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a projectile from close range to the bottom right corner, but Frederik Ronnow makes a nice save.
75' Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
75' Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) commits a rough challenge and Harm Osmers blows his whistle for a foul.
72' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
71' The ball goes out of play. Union Berlin are awarded a corner kick.
71' Steffen Baumgart has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alex Kral (Union Berlin) replacing Woo-Yeong Jeong.
69' Bayer Leverkusen failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) replaces Loic Bade.

67' Janis Blaswich pulls off a decent save! Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the middle of the net, but the effort is kept out.
65' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to threaten the goalkeeper as he takes the ball and fires from long range. The shot flies just over the crossbar!

64' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Bayer Leverkusen are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
62' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Bayer Leverkusen, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
61' Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ezequiel Fernandez.
61' Here is a change. Arthur is going off and Kasper Hjulmand gives the last tactical orders to Lucas Vazquez (Bayer Leverkusen).
61' A substitution has been made. Christian Kofane is replaced by Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen).
60' Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
60' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 3:2.
56' Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a mid-range free kick.
55' Harm Osmers has a clear sight and sees a foul from Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin).
54' Bayer Leverkusen are ruled offside.
52' One of the Bayer Leverkusen players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
51' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a superb stop.
51' The Bayer Leverkusen players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Bayer Leverkusen will look to take advantage of a free kick in a promising position in the middle of the field.

45+3' Bayer Leverkusen hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
45+2' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Loic Bade (Bayer Leverkusen), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
44' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
42' Bayer Leverkusen take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
41' A player from Union Berlin commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
40' Good work from Union Berlin as they win a corner.
39' Good movement by Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
38' Some great controlled play and passing from Bayer Leverkusen. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
35' Shots on target – 2:0.

33' The ball rebounds out to Ezequiel Fernandez (Bayer Leverkusen) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
32' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the bottom right corner. Janis Blaswich is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
28' 1 - 0 GOAL! Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Janis Blaswich, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 1:0.
27' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bayer Leverkusen.
27' Good clearance! Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
26' The ratio of the ball possession is 48:52.
22' Bayer Leverkusen control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

19' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but sends his header miles wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
18' A free kick from around the half-way line will be taken by Union Berlin.
16' Union Berlin have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
14' Neat passing move from Bayer Leverkusen in order to create new attacking opportunities.
11' Bayer Leverkusen have a goal-scoring opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
11' Steffen Baumgart is forced to make a change. Janik Haberer is unable to continue due to injury, Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) comes on.
10' Harm Osmers shows a yellow card to Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) for his blatant foul.
10' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
7' The resulting set piece from Union Berlin is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
6' Union Berlin will take a free kick from near the half-way line.
4' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
3' The game is interrupted now, Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
3' Stanley Nsoki (Union Berlin) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Harm Osmers had an easy-decision to make.
3' Harm Osmers blows his whistle and signals a foul after Stanley Nsoki (Union Berlin) brought his opponent down.
